grandline.gunners.no_ship: You have no ship of your own within 80 blocks to take gunners aboard.
grandline.gunners.full: Every gun of your ship is already manned.
grandline.gunners.poor: A gunner signs on for %s Beli; you cannot pay that.
grandline.gunners.hired: %1$s gunner(s) signed on and went aboard the %2$s for %3$s Beli (%4$s of %5$s guns manned by hired gunners). They fire on hostile ships while your order is fire at will (V) and you are within 64 blocks to hand out shot.
grandline.gunners.none: There are no hired gunners aboard your ship.
grandline.gunners.dismissed: %1$s hired gunner(s) paid off and sent ashore from the %2$s.
grandline.gunners.abandoned: Your %1$s hired gunner(s) swam for it as the %2$s went down.
grandline.gunners.menu: Gunners for the %1$s: %2$s guns, %3$s manned by hired gunners, %4$s free.
grandline.gunners.menu.hire_all: Man every free gun (%1$s for %2$s Beli)
grandline.gunners.menu.hire.desc: A gunner of skill %s mans one cannon and fires on pirate ships (and on Marine ships while you are wanted) with your shot. A one-off fee, no wages.
grandline.gunners.menu.dismiss.desc: Pay them off and send them ashore (no refund).
grandline.gunners.menu.at_yard: Talk to a shipwright or a dockworker to hire gunners.
grandline.gunners.no_yard: Gunners are hired from a shipwright or a dockworker: stand by one.
grandline.raid_plunder.taking: Raiders are carrying off goods from %s's market!
job.grandline.convoy.held: The %s waits in port: too many ships are at sea. She will put out as soon as there is room.
